responseMessageContents.text:
This confirms **`Ivan@1` is your AWS IAM user** and has AWS account-management and password-management permissions.

It does **not yet prove full administrator access or MFA**, so I cannot responsibly clear the AWS control item yet. Do **not** remove any permissions or users.

Please open, for `Ivan@1`:

1. **Security credentials** → send a screenshot showing **Assigned MFA device: Yes**.  
2. **Permissions** → open the Account Management policy and show its **policy summary**. If it does not show broad admin access, add a separate owner-only IAM administrator before changing anything.

Also, your screenshot exposed an AWS account number earlier—avoid sharing it in any more screenshots.
